question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current inline autogrow plus configurable send shortcut be considered sufficient?
rationale: The user problem is real and still missing from current main, but adding a second composition mode changes draft, focus, keyboard, and send semantics and needs maintainer UX direction before automation should implement it.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Add a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and tests for inline versus modal keyboard behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer Only
options.body: Close or narrow this request if maintainers decide the current autogrow textarea and modifier-send setting are the intended long-prompt path.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but leave it out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Add a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and tests for inline versus modal keyboard behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent review and current-main ownership trail for the chat composer and send-shortcut behavior.
